CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: re-running the .do logic on 3490_num.csv (N=2562; id = row number; codes 3, 8, 9 to missing; no other recode) reproduces the live table exactly -- 4874 rows, id-item-resp row sets identical (0/0 set differences, 0 duplicates) against the local irw cache copy written by table_context.R (no additional export). item x resp counts at 1/2/4/5: proble 76/1459/829/85, finmes 231/1274/707/213, identical rebuild vs live; per-item n proble 2449 / finmes 2425 = irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE).
